_comment: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets with this body (drop this key first: gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/rulesets --input ruleset.json). Rule type and parameter names (code_coverage, max_coverage_drop, minimum_coverage) are from https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules (create-a-repository-ruleset, read 2026-10-13); the page is a flattened table with no JSON example, so the exact body below is a reconstruction and was NOT executed against a live repo. Prerequisites: GitHub Code Quality enabled on the repo (UI toggle, no API), Cobertura coverage uploads on the default branch, Team or Enterprise Cloud plan or a public repo. The rule does not wait for coverage uploads: add a required_status_checks rule for every check that uploads coverage, or a PR can merge before its coverage lands. minimum_coverage 0 is assumed to mean no absolute floor (unverified).
name: Code coverage
